fabricated_details: Investigate Utility Power Fluctuation: Check electrical logs or consult with maintenance to identify the cause of the light flickering and unexpected equipment activation during the lunch period.
Verify Equipment Status: Confirm that no utility equipment (particularly HVAC M-14 or Compressor M-12) is operating in an abnormal state or has tripped/restarted unexpectedly.
Monitor for Recurrence: Keep an eye on the electrical stability of the plant, especially around peak load times.
rationale: The report correctly captures all facts but guesses a specific machine ID (M-14) for an ambiguous utility event, which is a minor accuracy error. It fabricates several pending items/actions not found in the input. Severity is assigned as Medium without strong evidence, though the uncertainty handling is good as it flags the ambiguity in the notes.
